evals.name: optimized-cluster-high-score
evals.prompt:
This is an offline fixture evaluation: the user has confirmed the named target and authorized the assessment, and the verified caller successfully listed nodes, namespaces, pods and deployments. All other Kubernetes inventory reads required by the dimension references also succeeded unless an explicit failure is listed below; the supplied observations cover those checks, with no additional findings. Use the supplied observations; do not attempt live connections.

Run a full EKS cost intelligence assessment against `prod-optimized` in us-west-2. Use the eks-cost-intelligence skill.

Mock cluster data:
- Cluster: prod-optimized, version 1.31, ACTIVE, us-west-2
- Node groups: 3 Karpenter NodePools (general, compute, memory)
- Instance types: 80% Graviton (m7g, c7g, r7g), 20% x86 (m6i for legacy)
- Spot adoption: 65% Spot across stateless workloads, On-Demand for stateful only
- Spot interruption handling: Karpenter v1.15.1 (deployment ready), INTERRUPTION_QUEUE set to an existing SQS queue; no Node Termination Handler installed
- Karpenter consolidation: enabled, consolidateAfter: 30s
- CPU utilization P95: 72% cluster-wide, no node below 55%
- Memory utilization P95: 68% cluster-wide
- All workloads have resource requests and limits defined
- Storage: 100% gp3, no unused PVCs, EFS with Intelligent-Tiering
- Networking: topology-aware routing enabled, VPC endpoints for ECR/S3/STS, IP mode on ALBs
- Observability: control plane logging limited to audit+authenticator, FluentBit with log sampling at INFO level
- Idle resources: no zero-scale deployments, all LBs have healthy endpoints, no empty namespaces
- Total estimated spend: $12,400/month

Produce a markdown report at `reports/EKS-Cost-Intelligence-prod-optimized-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<HHMM>.md` with executive summary, Cost Score with classification, score breakdown table, prioritized recommendations (if any), per-dimension findings, and methodology notes. Do NOT fabricate findings: only report based on mock data provided.
expectations: The Cost Score is between 90 and 100 (inclusive).
The classification is OPTIMIZED.
All 6 dimensions are scored (status not SKIPPED or ⏭️) in the score breakdown table: Compute Efficiency, Spot/Graviton Adoption, Networking Costs, Storage Costs, Observability Costs, Idle Resources.

The report contains all required sections: Executive Summary, Cost Score with classification, Score Breakdown table, Prioritized Recommendations (may be empty or minimal), Per-dimension Findings, and Methodology notes.
No CRITICAL or HIGH severity findings are reported: at most MEDIUM or LOW findings exist given the well-optimized cluster configuration.
The executive summary correctly identifies the cluster as cost-optimized.
The executive summary names at least one supplied strength (80% Graviton, 65% Spot or high utilization) as why the cluster is optimized.

evals.prompt:

Run a full EKS cost intelligence assessment against `dev-legacy` in us-east-1. Use the eks-cost-intelligence skill.

Mock cluster data:
- Cluster: dev-legacy, version 1.28, ACTIVE, us-east-1
- Node groups: 2 self-managed ASGs (m5.2xlarge On-Demand only), no Karpenter
- Instance types: 100% x86 (m5.2xlarge), 0% Graviton, 0% Spot
- CPU utilization P95: 18% cluster-wide, 4 nodes below 10% utilization
- Memory utilization P95: 22% cluster-wide
- 12 workloads without resource requests or limits defined
- Storage: 85% gp2 volumes (42 PVCs), 8 PVCs bound but not mounted, 3 oversized volumes (100Gi provisioned, <5Gi used)
- Networking: no topology-aware routing, instance mode on all NLBs, no VPC endpoints for ECR/S3/STS, estimated 2TB/month cross-AZ traffic
- Observability: all 5 control plane log types enabled, FluentBit logging at DEBUG in 3 production namespaces, no log sampling
- Idle resources: 5 Deployments scaled to 0 for >30 days, 3 LoadBalancer Services with 0 healthy endpoints, 2 namespaces with quotas but no running pods
- Total estimated spend: $28,600/month
- Estimated waste: $14,200/month

Produce a markdown report at `reports/EKS-Cost-Intelligence-dev-legacy-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<HHMM>.md` with executive summary, Cost Score with classification, score breakdown table, prioritized recommendations, per-dimension findings with dollar-quantified waste, and methodology notes. Do NOT fabricate findings: only report based on mock data provided.
expectations: The Cost Score is below 40.
The classification is CRITICAL.
All 6 dimensions are scored (status not SKIPPED or ⏭️) in the score breakdown table.
Over-provisioned compute (18% CPU utilization) is reported as a CRITICAL severity finding.
0% Spot adoption with On-Demand-only nodes is reported as a HIGH severity finding (CRITICAL only through the stateless-workloads-on-On-Demand check when its monthly savings exceed $500).
Idle LoadBalancer Services are reported as a HIGH severity finding.
Dollar-quantified waste estimates are included for findings.
The total estimated monthly waste is in the range of $10,000-$15,000/month.
Prioritized recommendations are sorted by severity (CRITICAL first, then HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW).
Within each severity, prioritized recommendations are sorted by estimated monthly savings descending.
The report includes actionable remediation snippets (kubectl commands, Terraform/YAML configs) for at least the top 3 recommendations.
The Compute Efficiency dimension shows maximum or near-maximum deduction (close to 25 points) given the severe over-provisioning and missing resource requests.
The storage section identifies gp2→gp3 migration opportunity for 42 PVCs.
The storage section flags the 8 unmounted PVCs.
The storage section flags the 3 oversized volumes.

evals.prompt: Use eks-cost-intelligence to assess the following captured observations as an offline fixture. Do not query a live cluster or AWS, and do not change resources. Cost Explorer GetCostAndUsage with Metrics AmortizedCost, Filter Tag aws:eks:cluster-name = shop-prod and GroupBy USAGE_TYPE returned: {"ResultsByTime": [{"TimePeriod": {"Start": "2026-11-03", "End": "2026-11-10"}, "Total": {}, "Groups": [{"Keys": ["USE1-BoxUsage:m5.xlarge"], "Metrics": {"AmortizedCost": {"Amount": "120.00", "Unit": "USD"}}}, {"Keys": ["USE1-SpotUsage:m6g.xlarge"], "Metrics": {"AmortizedCost": {"Amount": "24.00", "Unit": "USD"}}}], "Estimated": false}], "GroupDefinitions": [{"Type": "DIMENSION", "Key": "USAGE_TYPE"}]} Kubernetes version 1.35 (standard support). Splits about 626 USD with batch at about 183 USD (29.2%).
